The function MultiToken.transferOwnership(address) is controlled by the onlyOwner modifier, which means only the owner can change the ownership of the contract.

If the new owner decides to disable or enable token swaps, they can effectively control whether users can trade or not, thus limiting their ability to sell tokens.
